package domain_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func validDecision() domain.TeacherDecision {
	level := 2
	return domain.TeacherDecision{
		ID:                "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
		PersonalTeacherID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
		StudentID:         "student-1",
		CorrelationID:     "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
		LearningActionID:  "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
		TeachingMode:      domain.TeachingModePractice,
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:         "task-1",
		PedagogyMethod:    domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode,
		PedagogyVersion:   domain.ProgressiveHintMethodVersion,
		PedagogyStage:     domain.AMCDOrient,
		Strategy:          "Scaffolding",
		Action:            domain.TeacherActionGiveHint,
		HintLevel:         &level,
		ReasonCode:        "Repeated_Failure",
		ReasonSummary:     "Two failed attempts show the same prerequisite gap.",
		PolicyVersion:     "teaching-policy.v1",
		CreatedAt:         time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionNormalizesBusinessMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(validDecision())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "scaffolding", decision.Strategy)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, decision.PedagogyMethod)
	require.Equal(t, "repeated_failure", decision.ReasonCode)
	require.Equal(t, 2, *decision.HintLevel)
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionRequiresContextID(t *testing.T) {
	input := validDecision()
	input.ContextID = ""
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "context_id")
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionRequiresActionCorrelationForTaskContext(t *testing.T) {
	input := validDecision()
	input.LearningActionID = ""
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "learning_action_id")

	input = validDecision()
	input.CorrelationID = "request-1"
	_, err = domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "correlate")
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionValidatesPracticeStepBinding(t *testing.T) {
	input := validDecision()
	input.ContextType = domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
	input.PracticeStepID = " step-one "
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "step-one", decision.PracticeStepID)

	input = validDecision()
	input.PracticeStepID = "step-one"
	_, err = domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "practice_step_id")
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionRequiresHintLevelForHint(t *testing.T) {
	input := validDecision()
	input.HintLevel = nil
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "hint_level")
}

func TestNewTeacherDecisionForbidsHintsInExamMode(t *testing.T) {
	input := validDecision()
	input.TeachingMode = domain.TeachingModeExam
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(input)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "exam mode")
}

func TestNewIntegrationEventContainsRequiredEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(validDecision())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
		domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded,
		decision.CorrelationID,
		decision.CausationID,
		decision.StudentID,
		decision.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion,
		decision,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &envelope))
	var rawEnvelope map[string]json.RawMessage
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &rawEnvelope))
	for _, requiredField := range []string{"event_id", "event_type", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id", "occurred_at", "schema_version", "data"} {
		require.Contains(t, rawEnvelope, requiredField)
	}
	require.Equal(t, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", envelope.EventID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, envelope.EventType)
	require.Equal(t, "student-1", envelope.StudentID)
	require.Empty(t, envelope.CausationID)
	require.Equal(t, 2, envelope.SchemaVersion)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002","personal_teacher_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","student_id":"student-1","correlation_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004","learning_action_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004","teaching_mode":"practice","context_type":"lesson_task","context_id":"task-1","pedagogy_method":"adaptive","pedagogy_method_version":"progressive-hint-v1","pedagogy_stage":"orient","strategy":"scaffolding","action":"give_hint","hint_level":2,"reason_code":"repeated_failure","reason_summary":"Two failed attempts show the same prerequisite gap.","policy_version":"teaching-policy.v1","created_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z"}`, string(envelope.Data))
}
